item.title: Royal Mail reminds SMEs to apply for its apprenticeship funding
item.description: Retail Jeweller Royal Mail reminds SMEs to apply for its apprenticeship funding During National Apprenticeship Week (9 to 15 February), Royal Mail is reminding SMEs to apply for its apprenticeship levy transfer fund for small and medium-sized businesses. Royal Mail reminds SMEs to apply for its apprenticeship funding Alex O'Dea

item.title: Inhorgenta 2026 puts craftsmanship centre stage with live demonstrations
item.description: Retail Jeweller Inhorgenta 2026 puts craftsmanship centre stage with live demonstrations German trade show Inhorgenta will place craftsmanship firmly at the heart of its forthcoming 2026 edition, with a comprehensive programme of live demonstrations, curated special areas and hands on workshops. Inhorgenta 2026 puts craftsmanship centre stage with live demonstrations Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Trial of the Pyx held at Mansion House for first time in 777 year history
item.description: Retail Jeweller Trial of the Pyx held at Mansion House for first time in 777 year history The Lady Mayor of the City of London has welcomed the historic Trial of the Pyx to Mansion House for the first time in its 777 year history, as The Royal Mint submitted thousands of coins for independent testing. Trial of the Pyx held at Mansion House for first time in 777 year history Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Kit Heath unveils Mirage Reflect collection for SS26
item.description: Retail Jeweller Kit Heath unveils Mirage Reflect collection for SS26 Silver jewellery brand Kit Heath has introduced Mirage Reflect, a new 15 piece jewellery collection for SS26, designed to offer retailers a contemporary, versatile silver and gold plated assortment focused on layered styling and everyday wearability. Kit Heath unveils Mirage Reflect collection for SS26 Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Tributes paid to industry legend David Doyle following his passing
item.description: Retail Jeweller Tributes paid to industry legend David Doyle following his passing Tributes have poured in from across the UK jewellery trade following the passing of industry legend David Doyle, a widely respected figure whose decades of dedication, leadership and fundraising left a lasting impact on the sector. Tributes paid to industry legend David Doyle following his passing Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Smiling Rocks strengthens UK presence with key independent retail partnerships
item.description: Retail Jeweller Smiling Rocks strengthens UK presence with key independent retail partnerships Laboratory grown diamond jewellery brand Smiling Rocks is accelerating its UK expansion, securing distribution with a growing roster of independent retail partners following its official market launch last year. Smiling Rocks strengthens UK presence with key independent retail partnerships Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Betts Group brings net zero Bellevue Mine gold to UK via Titcombe Bespoke Jewellery
item.description: Retail Jeweller Betts Group brings net zero Bellevue Mine gold to UK via Titcombe Bespoke Jewellery The Betts Group has supplied the UK’s first batch of Single Mine Origin fine gold grain from the Bellevue Mine in Western Australia, with award winning independent Titcombe Bespoke Jewellery becoming the inaugural retail recipient. Betts Group brings net zero Bellevue Mine gold to UK via Titcombe Bespoke Jewellery Ruth Faulkner

item.title: SaferGems warns jewellers over rise in Apple Pay refund fraud
item.description: Retail Jeweller SaferGems warns jewellers over rise in Apple Pay refund fraud Jewellers across the UK are being urged to remain vigilant following a sharp rise in Apple Pay refund fraud, an emerging criminal tactic now impacting the wider retail sector, including jewellery businesses. SaferGems warns jewellers over rise in Apple Pay refund fraud Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Tasaki launches first-ever all-metal jewellery collection designed by Thakoon Panichgul
item.description: Retail Jeweller Tasaki launches first-ever all-metal jewellery collection designed by Thakoon Panichgul Japanese jewellery house Tasaki has unveiled its first-ever Metal Jewellery Collection, marking a new chapter for the brand’s design direction and expanding its iconic balance and danger horn series into all-metal creations. Tasaki launches first-ever all-metal jewellery collection designed by Thakoon Panichgul Ruth Faulkner

item.title: From Transparency to Transaction: PGI’s digital product passports
item.description: Retail Jeweller From Transparency to Transaction: PGI’s digital product passports The Platinum Guild Circle hopes to grow sales for jewellery retailers with the introduction of Digital Product Passports. Ruth Faulkner speaks to Platinum Guild International chief executive Tim Schlick and head of global business development Phil Romans to find out more.
